timezone_policy: All investigative timestamps in REPORT.md are UTC unless a source explicitly labels a local offset.

scope.scope_definition: Counts include every local file under investigation/tiktok except the committed derivatives (REPORT.md, campaign_iocs.*, template_fingerprint.json, qr_order_evidence.json, origin_observation.json, origin_inventory.*, source_correlation.json, evidence_manifest.json), .gitignore, and this manifest metadata; raw captures remain local and newly preserved origin-source records are included.

chain_of_custody.case_artifacts: Source capture IDs, report IDs, artifact hashes, and creation timestamps are retained in artifacts_tiktok.csv and the local raw capture tree.
chain_of_custody.collection_mode: Read-only HTTP/DNS/RDAP/RIPEstat/Shodan/public-source retrieval, public URLScan/GitHub/certificate-transparency correlation, plus one synthetic/public-user QR order with no payment.
chain_of_custody.preservation_note: Raw evidence remains outside the Git commit because it is large and includes session cookies, transaction tokens, third-party responses, correspondence, and unrelated credential-like public-code material. Fresh APNIC/RIPEstat records for both observed addresses and the public URLScan hash-search coverage are preserved under origin_sources/. Sanitized origin and source-correlation findings are committed separately; verify every local source against the hashes below under legal hold.
